_about: The one place GenClass plans are defined. telemetry-worker/src/plans.ts imports this file (limits, entitlements, Stripe lookup keys, the billing page) and site/build.py reads it (the pricing page). scripts/stripe-setup.mjs creates the Stripe products and prices from it. Prices are US cents. A null yearly price means no yearly option yet. limits.apps null means no plan limit (the worker still caps an account at 200 apps against abuse). Every plan includes the dashboard and interaction analytics (entitlements dashboard and analytics; a telemetry-worker test checks it): Free has them for every app, with no app limit, over the 90 days every app's data is kept anyway, so it costs no extra retention; Pro adds a year of history, export and forwarding. A trial gives Pro's entitlements for trial_days days, and starts only on Stripe Checkout with a card that is first charged when the trial ends (telemetry-worker/src/billing.ts): site/build.py reads trial_days for the public copy, the telemetry worker reads TRIAL_DAYS in telemetry-worker/wrangler.toml, and a telemetry-worker test checks that they agree (and that the CLI never says the dashboard needs Pro). Feature lines with available false are shown as coming next. stripe_tax_code is the Stripe product tax code scripts/stripe-setup.mjs sets on the plan's product; managed_payments true sells the plan through Stripe Managed Payments (Stripe, through Link, is the merchant of record; only for fully automated digital products, so Custom, which a person trains, is false; telemetry-worker/README.md, Paid plans).
footer: Need self-hosting, SSO or invoices? Email mehar@daybot.ca.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: The open-source runtime, its on-device model, and the dashboard with analytics for every app.

features.text: The open-source runtime (Apache-2.0) with every mode: observe, guard and heal
The dashboard: what GenClass found in each app, on which pages, and what it did
Interaction analytics: page views, time on page, scroll depth and clicks, for apps that turn them on
Reports in the browser console, or sent to your own webhook or function

plans.name: Pro
plans.summary: Everything in Free, plus a year of history, export and forwarding.

features.text: Full data export: every event GenClass received for your apps, as JSONL or CSV, by download or API
Forward detections to Sentry, PostHog, Datadog, Slack or a signed webhook

plans.name: Custom
plans.summary: Pro, plus a GenClass model trained on your own app.

features.text: A classifier trained for your app: we train a GenClass model on your app's own traffic and bug reports and ship it as a private model your runtime loads
A person from GenClass emails you within 1 business day of purchase to start
